model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the coverage achieved by four different models—Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT—as a function of the number of completions (k), which is plotted on the x-axis using a logarithmic scale ranging from 2^20 to 2^25. The y-axis represents coverage, scaled linearly from 0.4 to 0.8. The blue line with circular markers, representing Llama-3B, starts at a coverage of 0.42 when k=2^20 and increases to 0.84 at k=2^25. The green line with triangle markers, representing Llama-3B + FT, begins at 0.42 at k=2^20 and rises to 0.86 at k=2^25. The light blue line with diamond markers, representing Llama-1B, starts at approximately 0.28 at k=2^20 and increases to 0.82 at k=2^25. The light green line with inverted triangle markers, representing Llama-1B + FT, begins at approximately 0.28 at k=2^20 and rises to 0.84 at k=2^25. All four lines show an upward trend in coverage as k increases, with the Llama-3B + FT and Llama-1B + FT models reaching higher coverage values than the base models at the highest k values.
